# Star Wars Live-Action Adventures

Star Wars Live-Action Adventures is a 1996 tabletop game supplement published by West End Games for Star Wars.
Contents
Star Wars Live-Action Adventures is a supplement in which a LARP experience is provided for the Star Wars universe. The book includes a freeform scenario set on a Tatooine sandbarge, where ten characters vie for a critical object held by a criminal overlord. The setup has layered backstories and character entanglements—like a disfigured gunman tied to a mercenary turned Rebel. The bulk of the book is a rules system derived from the Star Wars game. It includes force points, dark side points, difficulty modifiers, and dice mechanics.
Reception
Andrew Rilstone reviewed Star Wars Live-Action Adventures for Arcane magazine, rating it a 6 out of 10 overall, and stated that "And that's a real shame, because this is a good idea, just badly fumbled."
